# My Blog

> Posts about Angular, AnalogJS and web dev. https://periwinkle32.github.io/ice-dream/

All pages are also available as raw Markdown by appending `.md` to the URL.

## Blog

- [Welcome to My Blog](https://periwinkle32.github.io/ice-dream/blog/welcome-to-my-blog.md): First post on this brand-new AnalogJS blog.
- [Content Routes in AnalogJS](https://periwinkle32.github.io/ice-dream/blog/content-routes-in-analogjs.md): Markdown content routes out of the box.
- [Prerendering Blog Posts](https://periwinkle32.github.io/ice-dream/blog/prerendering-blog-posts.md): Static generation of content routes.

## Pages

- [Getting Started](https://periwinkle32.github.io/ice-dream/page/getting-started.md): How this blog is built and how to write posts.
- [Astro Angular Integration](https://periwinkle32.github.io/ice-dream/page/astro-angular.md): Render Angular components as islands in Astro with @analogjs/astro-angular.
